title: A Summer to Remember
description: On holiday with her daughter in Fiji, a widowed doctor considered for an executive position at her hospital revises her priorities after falling in love with the charming owner of the resort.

title: The Suspect
description: Fenton, California is shocked when local lawyer Paul James, a model citizen and father, who was considering standing in municipal elections, is shot in his car in front of his home. His second wife Beth is arrested and charged for the crime.

title: The Wrong Patient
description: Katie, a successful plastic surgeon, becomes entangled in the web of a narcissist patient whose path to perfection threatens to destroy Katie and her family.

description: A woman with a personality disorder and a murderous past, invents a stalker with which she hopes to arouse the attention of her new neighbour.

title: Hometown Hero
description: After being forced to look after her client's dog, a cynical divorce mediator begins to have a change of heart. Thanks to the dog, she begins to spend more time with the local vet, and she begins to find that true love may not be so far away.

title: Do I Say I Do?
description: A relationship therapist gets put to the test while working with her ex-boyfriend to publish her book.

description: Just three days before their wedding day, Jess and Max are on the verge of calling it off. But the groom's brother will stop at nothing to ensure that this meant-to-be couple get hitched once and for all.
